goalOneSentence: Prove end-to-end correctness of a multi-protocol order pipeline — HTTP POST ingress, RabbitMQ publish to z101-input, relay bridge to z101-output, Consumer read, and HTTP GET egress — using a single QaaS runner suite with hermetic count guards on every output set.

tasks.title: Author mocker YAML (2 servers), runner YAML (4 sessions), and test data
tasks.description:
Author three files for the multi-protocol pipeline.

Mocker/z101.mocker.yaml: two Http servers. Server 1 Port 8271 (ingress): Path /order, Method Post, Action name post-order, TransactionStubName PostOrderStub. Server 2 Port 8272 (egress): Path /order/{id}/status, Method Get, Action name get-order-status, TransactionStubName GetStatusStub. Stubs section: PostOrderStub uses Processor StaticResponseProcessor, ProcessorConfiguration key (not TransactionData — FB s13#1) with Body '{"id":"z101-order-001","accepted":true}' StatusCode 202 ContentType application/json. GetStatusStub uses Processor StaticResponseProcessor, ProcessorConfiguration with Body '{"id":"z101-order-001","status":"processed"}' StatusCode 200 ContentType application/json. All paths lowercase with no leading slash issues (FB s13#5b): paths /order and /order/{id}/status are already lowercase.

Runner/z101.runner.qaas.yaml: RabbitMq config Host localhost Port 5672 Username admin Password admin. Storages list with one FileSystem entry Path ./session-data (FB s13#2 list-of-maps shape). DataSources: one entry Name OrderData, Generator FromFileSystem, GeneratorConfiguration with FileSystem {Path: TestData} (ONLY Path - no Pattern key exists, FB s13#20). Three sessions:
(1) post-ingress: one Transaction http Host localhost Port 8271 Method Post Route order (no leading slash, FB s13#5) DataSourceNames [OrderData] (required on Transactions, FB s13#3) ContentType application/json; Assertions HttpStatus StatusCode 202 OutputNames [post-ingress-out] (FB s13#4) and HermeticByExpectedOutputCount ExpectedCount 1 (FB s13#12).
(2) queue-roundtrip: a SINGLE session containing BOTH the Publisher (RabbitMq ExchangeName z101-input, RoutingKey /, DataSourceNames [OrderData]) AND the Consumer (Name consume-result, RabbitMq ExchangeName z101-output, RoutingKey /, TimeoutMs 30000, Deserialize Json). They MUST share one session so the consumer binds at action-stage 0 BEFORE the publisher fires at action-stage 1 (FB s13#24 - a consumer in a later session binds after the relay already forwarded and the broker drops the messages); Assertions on this session: HermeticByExpectedOutputCount {OutputNames: [consume-result], ExpectedCount: 1}. Do NOT add any topology probes (CreateRabbitMqExchanges etc.) - the relay.ps1 started by the harness declares both exchanges via the management API BEFORE the runner runs, and the runner csproj does not reference QaaS.Common.Probes (FB s13#8 - an unreferenced probe crashes hook resolution).
(3) get-egress-status: one Transaction http Host localhost Port 8272 Method Get Route order/z101-order-001/status (no leading slash, all lowercase) with DataSourceNames [OrderData] and TimeoutMs 5000; Assertions HttpStatus StatusCode 200 OutputNames [get-egress-out] and HermeticByExpectedOutputCount ExpectedCount 1.

Runner/TestData/order.json: a valid JSON payload representing an order, e.g. {"orderId":"z101-order-001","product":"widget","quantity":1}.

tasks.title: Run template gates on runner and mocker YAML files
tasks.description: Validate both the runner YAML and mocker YAML pass their respective template/syntax gates using the dotnet run template command before attempting any live run. This catches schema errors, unknown field names, missing required fields (DataSourceNames, TimeoutMs), drift-column field name mistakes (TransactionData vs ProcessorConfiguration, ExpectedStatus vs StatusCode), and route double-slash issues early without needing live infrastructure. For the runner: run 'dotnet run -c Release -- template z101.runner.qaas.yaml' from Runner/ and verify exit code 0 with no 'not found in' error text. For the mocker: run 'dotnet run -c Release -- template z101.mocker.yaml' from Mocker/ (if the mocker supports a template command) or verify the build succeeds and the yaml parses. The template command is the canonical pre-flight gate that must pass before any live run attempt.
acceptanceCriteria: dotnet run -- template exits 0 for runner YAML
no 'not found in' error in template output
Mocker project builds cleanly
rubric: Runner template gate passes with exit 0
No unknown field errors in template output
Mocker project compiles without errors
failureModes: template exits non-zero due to unknown field name (drift violation)
template exits non-zero due to missing required DataSourceNames or TimeoutMs
Mocker build fails due to wrong NuGet package version

tasks.title: Run live end-to-end: start mocker and relay, execute runner suite, stop both
tasks.description: Execute the full end-to-end Z101 pipeline live. Sequence: (1) Start the mocker as a background process using Start-Process dotnet with -WorkingDirectory pointing to the Mocker/ folder resolved from Runner/ as ..\Mocker; capture the process handle. (2) Start the relay bridge using Start-Process powershell invoking ..\relay.ps1 with -InputExchange z101-input -OutputExchange z101-output -TimeoutSec 150; capture the process handle. The relay.ps1 uses the RabbitMQ management API at localhost:15672 with credentials admin:admin; it declares both exchanges and polls z101-input, forwarding messages to z101-output. (3) Wait 10 seconds for mocker and relay to become ready. (4) Run 'dotnet run -c Release -- run z101.runner.qaas.yaml' from Runner/ cwd; capture the exit code and verify the output contains ExitCode=0. (5) Stop the relay process using Stop-Process -Id with the captured PID; stop the mocker process the same way. (6) Exit with the captured runner exit code. Also write Runner/RUN-REPORT.md documenting: the exact commands used, expected boot sequence (mocker first then relay then runner), exchange names z101-input and z101-output, port assignments 8271 ingress and 8272 egress, expected log lines, and failure triage steps.

verify.cmd: $m = Start-Process dotnet -ArgumentList 'run','-c','Release','--','run','z101.mocker.yaml' -WorkingDirectory (Resolve-Path ..\Mocker) -PassThru; $r = Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File','..\relay.ps1','-InputExchange','z101-input','-OutputExchange','z101-output','-TimeoutSec','240' -PassThru; $ok=$false; foreach($i in 1..60){ try{ (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1',8271)).Close(); (New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient('127.0.0.1',8272)).Close(); $ok=$true; break }catch{ Start-Sleep 2 } }; if(-not $ok){ Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Process -Id $r.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'MOCKER PORTS NEVER BOUND'; exit 9 }; dotnet run -c Release -- run z101.runner.qaas.yaml; $code=$LASTEXITCODE; Stop-Process -Id $r.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Stop-Process -Id $m.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit $code
